# BAD-015 — Public profile pages at my.badtakes.io/@handle

## Brief
From BadTakes TODO.md item 32, phase 4. Handles and profiles shipped 2026-08-21 (phases 1 and 2). Phase 3, admin moderation, appears built as of 2026-09-14: admin/src/components/ProfileControls.tsx has suspend, unsuspend and release, and admin/src/app/accounts/handles/reserved exists. Confirm release pairs with a reserved_handles entry as the design requires, then close that half out.

Phase 4 is not built: firebase.json has no /@ route, and the app already displays my.badtakes.io/@handle (src/handles.js PROFILE_HOST, web/account.js) as a URL that resolves to nothing.

Scope:
- A public profile page at my.badtakes.io/@handle with correct OG tags, since the URL is meant to be pasted into a bio or a group chat. Suspended profiles 404. Read access through a read-only role with column-level grants; email is never granted.
- The design (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-20-user-profiles-and-handles-design.md) calls for a second Firebase App Hosting backend with SSR and 60-second ISR. The later public scene pages design (2026-09-09) chose prerendered static pages on the same host instead. Reconcile the two approaches before building.

Out of scope (Eric, 2026-09-14): the export end cards. They are done and already get added to the videos; the functions that make them work are not to be touched. The end-card change the 2026-08-20 design describes (my.badtakes.io/@handle in place of badtakes.io on both cards) is not part of this ticket.

Note my.badtakes.io is Cloudflare-proxied with a long edge cache, which matters for how fresh a profile page is.

## Size, persona and model decision
Narrowed 2026-09-14 by Eric: the end-card change is out; the end cards are done and their functions stay untouched. What remains: an architect (fable, default tier) confirms phase 3 with evidence and reconciles the 2026-08-20 SSR/ISR backend against the 2026-09-09 prerender choice into a dated spec, since the choice is infrastructure and expensive if wrong; then one engineer (opus, default tier) builds the pages from the spec. Carola (02) was planned for the end cards and stopped before her first edit.

## Outcome
Shipped in three PRs plus two fixes: https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/346 (the profiles_web role and the CI password step), https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/349 and https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/350 (the step accepts the CLI's pooler-url as written and sends the SQL on stdin, since psql -c never substitutes variables), https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/347 (the badtakes-profiles Cloud Run service and deploy-profiles.yml) and https://github.com/0snug0/BadTakes/pull/348 (the Hosting rewrites, robots.txt, docs and the TODO item 32 closure). Live on 2026-09-14: my.badtakes.io/@handle answers through Cloudflare with cf-cache-status DYNAMIC and cache-control public, max-age=0, s-maxage=60; a non-canonical form 308s to the canonical URL; an unknown or suspended handle 404s with the service's CSP; /sitemap-profiles.xml lists 187 active handles; robots.txt names it. Phase 3 confirmed complete with file:line evidence in the spec. The end-card URL change stayed out by Eric's decision. Eric's setup: PROFILES_DB_PASSWORD, the profiles-db-url secret (its first version carried a pasted placeholder, caught by the service's boot check), and the two IAM confirmations.
